title: Ultimate Brass Knuckles - Unleash the Ultimate Power!
description: Step into the game with Ultimate Brass Knuckles! Inspired by the legendary Ultimate Fist, this mod introduces an overpowered tool that obliterates enemies and crushes blocks with ease.
body:
Ultimate Brass Knuckles – The Ultimate Mining & Combat Tool

Step into true power with Ultimate Brass Knuckles.
Inspired by the legendary Ultimate Fist, this mod adds an insanely overpowered tool that destroys enemies and mines entire areas in seconds.

⭐ Core Features
⚔️ Insane Damage & Speed

Breaks blocks at insane speed – even obsidian is nothing.

High melee damage for brutal close-range combat.

💥 Multi-Range Mining Modes
![Block Breaking](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b2432e1bd3b1f62adc27a93836f1d8a7b7bb1779.gif)
Choose exactly how large you want to mine:

1×1 – Precision Mode

3×3 – Small Area

6×6 – Medium Area

10×10 – Large Area

Switch sizes anytime with:

Shift + Right-Click → opens the UBK Settings Menu
Inside the menu, you can select your preferred mining size with a single click.
![Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/daad5b372c4b6726042670e4a5891720943d91db.png)
🎯 Smart Directional Mining

The tool automatically adjusts the mining plane based on the face you hit:

Hit the top of a block → mines a horizontal layer

Hit the side of a block → mines a vertical wall

No more random or diagonal holes – you always mine exactly the surface you’re looking at.

🔧 Advanced Tool Modes

All modes can be toggled inside the custom in-game menu:

🔥 Auto-Smelt Mode

Automatically smelts:

Ores → ingots

Stone-related blocks → their furnace-smelted variants

cobblestone → stone → smooth stone

Mob drops:

Raw meat → cooked meat

Raw fish → cooked fish

🧲 Magnet Mode

Pulls all mined drops directly into your inventory.

No more running around picking up items.

✨ Silk Touch Mode

Mine blocks in their original form.

Works together with all mining sizes (1×1, 3×3, 6×6, 10×10).

⛏ Vein-Miner Mode

Break one ore block or log → mines the entire connected vein/tree.

Full 3D (26-direction) detection.

📏 Adjustable Vein Limit

Choose how many blocks a single Vein-Miner action can break:

64

128

256

512

Perfect to avoid lag on huge ore veins or giant modded trees.

🖥️ Custom In-Game Settings Menu

Open the settings UI anytime with:

Shift + Right-Click while holding the Ultimate Brass Knuckles

Inside the menu you can toggle:

Mining Size

Auto-Smelt

Magnet Mode

Silk Touch Mode

Vein-Miner Mode

Vein Limit (64 / 128 / 256 / 512)

Close button


Practically unbreakable

Designed for late-game god-tier mining and combat

🔨 Crafting

Forged from:

Netherite

Diamond

A touch of destructive energy

![Crafting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69c5612e0737600939313b9a64bb5c936ce19072.png)

🏆 Dominate Your World

Crush blocks, shred enemies, vein-mine entire caves and forests, and control everything through the in-game menu.

Download Ultimate Brass Knuckles now –
and unleash true destruction.
